title: M-A100226-01 RFP for NWS ERS-30, WS ERS-30, NWS ERS-10 and WS ERS-10 for the SCT of December 1, 2026, through March 31, 2027

documents.text:
Market Notice Details

To:

Notice_Contracts@lists.ercot.com

Sent:

10/2/26, 11:25 AM

Subject:

M-A100226-01 RFP for NWS ERS-30, WS ERS-30, NWS ERS-10 and WS ERS-10 for the SCT of December 1, 2026, through March 31, 2027

NOTICE DATE:
 October 2, 2026

NOTICE TYPE:
 M-A100226-01 
Contracts/RFP

SHORT DESCRIPTION:

RFP for NWS ERS-30, WS ERS-30, NWS ERS-10 and WS ERS-10 for the SCT of December 1, 2026, through March 31, 2027

INTENDED AUDIENCE:

Qualified Scheduling Entities (QSEs)

DAYS AFFECTED:
 October 30, 2026; November 9, 2026

LONG DESCRIPTION: 
ERCOT has issued a Request for Proposal (RFP) for Emergency Response Service (ERS) for the Standard Contract Term (SCT) of December 1, 2026, through March 31, 2027. This RFP seeks participants for Non-Weather-Sensitive ERS-30 (
NWS ERS-30), Weather-Sensitive ERS-30 (WS ERS-30), Non-Weather-Sensitive ERS-10 (NWS ERS-10) and Weather-Sensitive ERS-10 (WS ERS-10)
.

ERS Resource Identification (ERID) information is due to ERCOT no later than October 30, 2026. Competitive offers and self-provision offers are due by November 9, 2026.

Please visit the 
Emergency Response Service
 page of the ERCOT website for the RFP and all other documents associated with this procurement.

ADDITIONAL INFORMATION:

ERCOT will communicate awarded offers to QSEs no later than November 20, 2026.   The ERS Procurement Summary will be posted to the ERCOT Market Information System (MIS) prior to the start of the SCT.

CONTACT:
 If you have any questions, please contact your ERCOT Account Manager. You may also call the general ERCOT Client Services phone number at (512) 248-3900 or contact ERCOT Client Services via email at 
ClientServices@ercot.com
.

If you are receiving email from a public ERCOT distribution list that you no longer wish to receive, please follow this link in order to unsubscribe from this list: 
http://lists.ercot.com
.
